people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: King of Israel, son of Jehoash.

translations.web: For Amos says, ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’ ”
translations.bsb: for this is what Amos has said: ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword, and Israel will surely go into exile, away from their homeland.’”
translations.kjv: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land.
translations.asv: For thus Amos saith, Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.
